Yesterday, I had a very productive meeting with the incoming Governor of Ogun State, Senator Solomon Adéọlá Olamilekan Yayi @Sen_AdeolaYAYI , where we discussed the future of our dear state.

One thing that stood out was his interest in the aspirations of young people, particularly Gen Z, who will play a defining role in shaping Ogun’s future. We discussed the need to create direct channels for young people to engage with the government, share feedback and contribute meaningfully to policymaking. After all, you cannot build a future for young people without giving them a voice in shaping it.

Building a state is a continuous process. The progress made under Governor Dapo Abiodun’s ISEYA provides a foundation upon which we can build, consolidate and advance our collective aspirations as a people. 

For me, the journey from ISEYA to ITESIWAJU is about moving Ogun State forward, building on the gains of today to realise the greater possibilities of tomorrow.

I believe in Senator YAYI, I believe in what his ITESIWAJU agenda represents, and I believe in his bold, practical and vivid vision for Ogun State. 

I will do everything within my power to support his emergence as Governor and contribute to the realisation of the Ogun State of our dreams.

This is bigger than politics for me. It is about the future of our people, the opportunities available to our young people and the kind of state we want to leave for the next generation.

ITESIWAJU is more than a political aspiration; it is a promise of a brighter future, greater opportunities and a better Ogun State for all of us under a Solomon Adeola Olamilekan Yayi leadership.
